Design, code and sound

I'm a second-year Computer Science student at Tibiscus University in Timișoara, focused on frontend development. I graduated from an arts high school, so I care about how an interface looks and feels as much as how it is built.

Alongside web work, I set up and run live sound for concerts and sing bass in a choir. Both have taught me precision, teamwork and how to listen.
